concerns.text: Success criterion SC-003 ('attribution scores are measured against independent physical measurements') is not linked to any task; no task verifies attribution against external physical measurements, making the criterion untestable.

Success criterion SC-004 ('total execution time of the training and evaluation pipeline is measured against the 6‑hour limit') is not covered by any task; no task records or asserts total wall‑clock time for the end‑to‑end run.
The plan describes a synthetic‑benchmark fallback when no real RI dataset is found, but there is no corresponding task implementing this fallback step.

The plan adds a 'merge_predictions' step to produce results/prediction_results_{i}_{j}.csv conforming to output.schema.yaml, yet no task (e.g., T0xx) is defined for this step, breaking traceability from FR‑006 and schema validation.
